name: custom-additional-context
description: Automatically inject custom additional context into each conversation using UserPromptSubmit hook

interface.shortDescription: Inject custom context from cac.md file into conversations
interface.longDescription: This plugin uses the UserPromptSubmit hook to automatically inject custom additional context from a cac.md file into each conversation. The cac.md file should be located in ~/.codex/plugins-config/custom-additional-context/. Use the default prompts below to quickly set up the configuration.
defaultPrompt: Set up my custom additional context from cac.md file.
Help me create the cac.md configuration file.
Configure additional context to be injected automatically.

Windows PowerShell: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.codex\plugins-config\custom-additional-context"; New-Item -ItemType File -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.codex\plugins-config\custom-additional-context\cac.md" -Force
